Government addresses concerns over E20 fuel and vehicle damage

Concerns have been raised regarding the potential for E20 petrol to cause damage to car fuel tanks and affect insurance policies. The government has responded to these claims, clarifying the situation and addressing public apprehension. This clarification aims to provide accurate information about the effects of the E20 fuel blend.
